notes.note: Reviewed this record against the test-impact selector changes and their callers. Dependency-derived edges compare changed direct Kontour declarations/resolved importer versions, scan actual TypeScript import specifiers and add explicit suites; third-party/transitive changes are excluded, and more than16 importing suites defers to test-full. Workspace detection now reads declared workspace manifests even without a lockfile change; reproduced an incorrect workspace-SDK deferral before the fix, then its exclusion assertion passed. Supplemental edges retain existing boundaries and escalation behavior. The missing Agent-audience authority edge reproduced14PASS1FAIL; repaired15PASS. The Agent-audience production route suite is also explicit for escalated selections; removing only that edge caused the specific execution-selection assertion to fail, exact source restoration verified and selector+actualcaller33PASS. Four focused selector suites260PASS2existingSkip. Native platform scan joins the ci-fast static list and policy mirror; SDK client portability joins repo scans. Reviewed the testing guide explanation and commands; unrelated configuration/brand/runtime contracts remain outside this selector change. These checks prove selection and bounded caller behavior, not all deferred suite execution, native/device/provider qualification or canonical completion. FullCI, normal hooks and hosted new-head evidence remain required.
